That investigation.md amendment is deliberately sequenced to land after this precheck and before any reviewer identity is reserved, in the same window every prior Amendment Re-Review Context entry describes for itself: an investigation.md amendment is pinned by the reviewer invocation manifests of the round that reviews it, not by that round's precheck.
